dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you have a falling out with them?

dialogues.speaker: Havu
dialogues.text: ...Well, if you mean a fight, then yeah, we've fought before. But it's nothing serious. It's not my fault that I'm so strong, it's theirs for being too weak!

dialogues.speaker: Havu
dialogues.text: Hmph! It's all because they don't know how strong I am! When they find out... Well, I'm not gonna let them off the hook so easy either way. That's what they get for starting it! Hmph!
